name: Bela Vista Hotel & Spa
positioning: Clifftop hotel at Praia da Rocha in the Algarve, set across three houses including a 1918 palace that has welcomed guests since 1934
best_for: Couples who want a historic clifftop base above Praia da Rocha
Travelers who want a Spa by L'Occitane and sea-and-food experiences such as fishing with the chef

facts.text: The hotel has welcomed guests since 1934 in a palace built as a private villa in 1918.
The Palacete is the original 1918 villa, built for a canning industrialist.
The hotel occupies three houses above the beach: the Palacete, Casa Azul, which faces the Atlantic, and Casa Jardim, which opens onto the garden.
Bela Vista sits on the clifftop at Praia da Rocha in Portimao, in the Algarve.
The Palacete's style blends Portuguese heritage with oriental echoes in warm tones, deep blues and golden details.
In the Palacete, rooms have antique colors, oil-painted details and painted ceilings.
In Casa Jardim, wardrobes and details are inspired by old fishermen's houses.
The spa is a Spa by L'Occitane with couples treatment rooms, a sauna, a steam bath and a wet relaxation area with a plunge pool.
The hotel has an outdoor pool with a panoramic view and a fully equipped gym with ocean views.
At Vista restaurant, fish and seafood arrive daily from Algarve ports, and the Chef's Table is a small private table for two inside the kitchen.
The city centre and the villages of Alvor and Ferragudo are a short distance from the hotel.
Guests can join pottery-making workshops guided by local Algarve artisans.

highlights.text: Casa Azul faces the Atlantic and is the sunniest part of the hotel.
Guests can go on a fishing trip with Chef Joao Oliveira that ends with a fresh meal.
Guests can explore the Algarve coast aboard a private yacht, admiring its caves and cliffs.
An oyster experience includes a guided visit to local oyster farms and a tasting paired with regional wines.

considerations.text: Because the original architecture has been preserved, some rooms do not have a balcony.
The hotel is not recommended for children.
The fishing trip with the chef and the oyster experience are subject to sea and weather conditions.
